19/2024
M/s Floorex Tiles vs. M/s Crystal Ceramic Industries
Present:-
Sh. Subodh Walia, Advocate for plaintiff.
Arguments not addressed. 
Heard. 
On request, the case stands adjourned to 04.01.2025 for
arguments on the application under Order 23 Rule 1 CPC read along with
Order 7 Rule 10 CPC, order 13 Rule 7 (2), Section 16 of Court Fees Act and
Section 151 CPC.
No documents have been placed on record regarding pre-
institution of mediation under Section 12 A.
Same be filed on 04.01.2025.
Date of Order: 24.12.2024
Sameer, Steno Gr. III
Ashwani Kumar
Additional District Judge-cum-
Presiding Judge, Commercial
Court, Chandigarh UID-HR0106
